The petitioner aged about 57 years is seeking compensation in the wake of Detailed

(offending vehicle) being driven by respondent no. 1 in a rash and negligent manner.

Dar filed by police, was treated as claim petition under Section 166(4) of Motor
Vehicles Act, 1988 (hereinafter referred to as 'Mv Act').
2.

According to Dar, on 20.02.2019, the petitioner i.e. Sh. Ram Niwas, his grandchildren namely

They all were removed to Srhc Hospital, Narela, Delhi.

The offending vehicle was found to be

As per the documents (Ex. PW4/1 to Ex.4/3 colly) produced by PW4, petitioner had been appointed as Oil Man with Sugar Mill on 18.06.1979 on seasonal rates basis.
Bare perusal of salary sheet (Ex. PW4/3 colly) for the month of December, 2018 produced by PW4 reveals that basic salary of petitioner was Rs. 37,500/ in the said month.

It is pertinent to mention here that petitioner was working with aforesaid Sugar Mill on seasonal rate basis so the aforesaid amount can not be considered as monthly salary of petitioner at the time of accident.
It may be noted here that a seasonal job is not a fixed job and salary thereupon is also not fixed.

In view of the aforesaid discussion, I am not inclined to accept the monthly income of petitioner as Rs. 40,226/.
28.

It is relevant to note here that while deciding claim petition under M.V Act, it is the duty of Claim Tribunal to follow the principles of justice, equity and good conscience and to adopt more realistic, pragmatic and liberal approach.

It is pertinent to mention here that though, the working and earning of the petitioner has not been properly proved by him, however, it can not be denied that a person who was working as Oil Man in a firm since 1979 would have attain the expertize in his area of Oil Man and the fixing of notional income of such an experience person attains special significance.
Thus, loss of income of petitioner has to be assessed while taking the income of a skilled person under Minimum Wages Act applicable in the state of Haryana during the period in question.

The minimum wages of a skilled person were Rs. 10,729/ per month in the State of Haryana at MACP No. 515/19; FIR No. 61/19.; PS. Narela DOD: 04.05.2023 the time of accident in question, which had occurred on 20.02.2019.
